anacorp-ana-corp:lever:e2ea810c-aefc-4d4.title: Director of Enterprise Process Transformation
anacorp-ana-corp:lever:e2ea810c-aefc-4d4.description: About ANA: Join a recognized industry leader - Alliance North America was proudly named a 2025 Top Workplace in the Manufacturing Industry, an honor based entirely on feedback from our own employees about our culture, values, and workplace experience. Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, and ANA’s patented EBOSS® Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada, with locations in Cypress, California, and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling, and we are seeking a Director of Enterprise Process Transformation in an onsite position in Henderson, Nevada. The Director of Enterprise Process Transformation will own the design and governance of ANA’s end-to-end business processes and ensure they are properly implemented and adhered to across the company’s departments and platforms. This role will establish and maintain a unified process architecture across operations, HR, finance, IT, sales, marketing, engineering, support, and supply chain, ensuring departmental decisions support downstream workflows and system integrity. The objective is to create a coherent operating model supported by well-integrated enterprise systems, enabling ANA to scale efficiently. This role requires someone who can lead cross-department change, influence teams across the organization, and ensure that new processes and systems are not only designed well but fully adopted. The position is fully onsite, and the work schedule is weekdays from 8:00 AM-5:00 PM. This role reports to the VP of Finance and IT.
responsibilities: Map and document ANA’s core end-to-end workflows, including:
Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and cross-department failure points.
Enterprise Systems Design - Translate business processes into documented system workflows across ANA’s technology stack, including:
Finance, operations, HR and reporting platforms (including Power BI)
Master data and permission governance structures
Establish governance for how processes are created, modified, and maintained.
Evaluate departmental process changes for downstream operational and system impacts.
Drive operational efficiency through automation, standardization, and system optimization.
Reduce manual workarounds and process delays.
Improve the quality and consistency of operational and financial data.
Improve effective use of core platforms such as Business Central and Salesforce.
Partner with leadership and teams to ensure processes are correctly executed within systems.
Provide guidance and training to support adoption of improved workflows.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, operations, information systems, or related fields.
10–15+ years leading enterprise process transformation, ERP architecture, and business operational systems implementation.
Demonstrated success driving cross-functional change in organizations where processes span multiple departments and systems.
Experience implementing or rescuing ERP/CRM transformations where adoption, governance, and workflow discipline were required across teams.
Strong, successful experience aligning ERP (Business Central or Microsoft Dynamics), CRM (Salesforce or similar), and operational systems into a coherent operating model.
Proven ability to navigate organizational resistance and drive adoption of new processes and systems.
Experience operating in manufacturing, operationally complex, or rapidly scaling companies strongly preferred.
Deep understanding of enterprise operational workflows across finance, operations, sales, supply chain, HR, and support.
Experience translating business processes into system architecture across ERP, CRM, and enterprise platforms.
Strong understanding of data governance, system integrations, and enterprise reporting environments (e.g., Power BI).
Attributes:
Change driver – Comfortable challenging the status quo and pushing the organization toward disciplined processes and system adoption.
Influential communicator – Able to command a room, build credibility quickly, and lead cross-department discussions with senior leaders.
Organizational diplomat – Skilled at navigating personalities, incentives, and departmental friction to move change forward.
Systems thinker – Understands how decisions in one department cascade across operations, finance, and enterprise systems.
Process architect – Able to design workflows that scale with the business and eliminate operational friction.
Operationally fluent – Comfortable working directly with operations, finance, engineering, IT, and sales teams.
Business-to-system translator – Converts operational needs into system logic, automation, and integrated workflows across ERP and CRM platforms.
Relentless executor – Focused on ensuring processes are actually adopted, not just designed.
Expected Impact:
Within the first 12 months, this role should deliver:
Clear ownership and governance of ANA’s end-to-end business processes across departments
Strong integration between Business Central, Salesforce, and other core systems
Streamlined, documented workflows that eliminate friction & manual workarounds, improve efficiencies including speed & accuracy
Access for Leadership to consistent, accurate and standardized KPIs & dashboards that reduce manual reporting and improve decision speed
A scalable process and systems foundation to support ANA’s growth

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:5b5.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. This position combines strategic business acumen with strong operational expertise to drive both culinary and retail business performance while delivering #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8b8a3d66-a766-.title: Engineer II - Cyber Incident Response
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8b8a3d66-a766-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineer II - Cyber Incident Response based in India. This is a mid-level cybersecurity role within a global Security Operations Center (SOC), focused on detecting, investigating, and responding to cyber threats. You will analyze complex security alerts, logs, and forensic evidence to understand the scope and impact of incidents. The role plays an important part in containing threats, minimizing business disruption, and strengthening organizational security. You will work closely with cyber defense, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and forensics teams in a collaborative environment. You will also contribute to improving incident response playbooks, processes, detection capabilities, and security tooling. The position offers an opportunity to deepen technical expertise while supporting and mentoring less experienced security professionals. This is a full-time, remote opportunity for candidates based in India. Investigate and respond to cybersecurity incidents, including phishing, malware, ransomware, unauthorized access attempts, and other security threats. Analyze security logs, alerts, endpoint data, and forensic artifacts to determine the nature, scope, severity, and potential business impact of incidents. Conduct detailed incident investigations using SIEM, EDR, network analysis, and forensic technologies. Support containment, eradication, and recovery activities to minimize the impact of security incidents and restore normal operations. Escalate complex or high-severity incidents to senior cybersecurity personnel, providing clear documentation, investigative evidence, and recommended actions. Develop, maintain, and continuously improve SOC playbooks, runbooks, standard operating procedures, and incident response processes. Collaborate with threat intelligence, vulnerability management, digital forensics, and other cyber defense teams to strengthen detection and response capabilities. Participate in post-incident reviews and lessons-learned activities, identifying opportunities to improve processes, tooling, and security controls. Support junior security analysts by sharing technical knowledge and providing guidance on investigative and incident response techniques. Apply established cybersecurity frameworks and incident response methodologies to investigations and operational activities. Maintain clear and accurate documentation of investigations, findings, escalations, and response actions. Operate effectively in a fast-paced environment where rapid analysis, sound judgment, and timely escalation are essential. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 2 years of experience in incident response, SOC operations, security operations, or a related technical cybersecurity field , with the broader profile ideally reflecting approximately 5+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience. Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, incident response methodologies, and common adversary tactics and techniques. Hands-on experience with security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, and forensic tools , with experience using platforms such as Splunk, CrowdStrike, or Wireshark preferred. Demonstrated ability to investigate and correlate logs, alerts, endpoint information, network activity, and other artifacts. Solid proficiency in at least one primary technical cybersecurity area, such as endpoint forensics, together with working knowledge of an adjacent discipline such as cloud security. Familiarity with recognized cybersecurity and incident response frameworks, including NIST, MITRE ATT&CK, and ISO 27035 . Strong analytical, investigative, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to make sound decisions during high-pressure incidents. Excell
